AgentMessageRouting.description:
Optional delivery and work targeting for operational agent communication.
Legacy shaping discussion remains valid without routing metadata.

AgentRoleKind.description:
Semantic responsibility of a role. This is explicit rather than inferred
from a display name so authority, routing, and model prompts agree on who
may produce independent review findings.

billing_operation_id.description:
Platform-credit execution cites its durable billing preflight hold.
Local compute and BYOK never masquerade as platform-billed work.

isolation.description:
`None` is accepted only while replaying legacy events. New execution
starts are required by authority to provide a validated descriptor.

review_resolution.description:
Durable outcome of the review boundary. This prevents resolved
worktrees from reappearing after event replay or application restart.

base_revision.description:
Immutable Git commit from which this execution's changes are measured.
Required for Git worktrees and absent for a shared read-only checkout.

source_attempt_id.description:
Present only for `review_candidate`; points to the exact immutable
attempt identity whose candidate filesystem is being reviewed.

ExecutionIsolationKind.description:
Canonical identity of the filesystem namespace assigned to one execution.
Absolute paths deliberately stay in the host runtime: this descriptor is
safe to persist and synchronize across desktop and cloud authorities.

oneOf.description: Read-only agents may inspect the shared project checkout.
Writable agents execute in a detached Git worktree.

A read-only reviewer is attached to one unresolved writable attempt's
checkout. The worker remains its sole owner.

review_target_task_id.description:
For an independent review task, identifies the dependency whose
unresolved candidate checkout must be inspected. This is explicit so
scheduling never guesses from titles, role names, or dependency order.

ShapingMemoryNote.description:
One durable fact in the Principal's work-item brain: a decision reached,
an approval granted, a user preference, a revision change with its reason,
or an option considered and rejected with cause. Append-only — entries are
never edited or removed, only rotated out past the bound.

ShapingProposal.description:
Latest structured result of a Principal shaping turn. This is a bounded
desktop projection record, not executable authority: it can describe a
plan, but it cannot create agents, grant permissions, or start tasks.

ShapingRecords.description:
Complete normalized shaping knowledge for one proposal revision. Records
retain stable identities when their normalized text is unchanged, making
them safe targets for later plans, contracts, assignments, and reviews.

agent_instance_id.description: Draft and proposed contracts deliberately have no runtime agent.

preferred_model_route.description:
Optional per-role model route. `None` delegates selection to the
workspace launch policy; explicit routes remain bound to this contract.

description:
One immutable semantic fact. `sequence` is monotonic within `work_item_id`;
it is not a global database order and must not be synthesized by a renderer.
title: WorkspaceEventEnvelope
